The fault is in [parse.go](/app/lib/utils/parse/parse.go:117): `Variable` parses template expressions, but the package has no `Matcher` interface, `Match` function, or matcher types. Its AST walker accepts only `email.local`, so `regexp.match` and `regexp.not_match` cannot be parsed. The checked-in [parse tests](/app/lib/utils/parse/parse_test.go:27) cover interpolation only; they pass.

The fix belongs primarily in `parse.go`. It needs to parse one matcher expression, reject variable parts and transforms, validate function names and string arguments, and preserve static prefix and suffix text. [GlobToRegexp](/app/lib/utils/replace.go:19) provides the existing wildcard conversion; converted patterns need anchors. `Variable` also needs the specified matcher-function error.

One behavior remains uncertain from the local code and tests: whether regex function arguments should match a substring or the whole input. The requirements explicitly call for anchors on converted globs only. I recorded the findings in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). Project source and tests were not changed.

Implemented matcher expressions in [parse.go](/app/lib/utils/parse/parse.go), including literal, wildcard, raw regexp, `regexp.match`, and `regexp.not_match` support. The parser validates function calls, rejects matcher functions in `Variable()`, and preserves static prefixes and suffixes. Added focused coverage in [parse_test.go](/app/lib/utils/parse/parse_test.go).

The parse package tests and `git diff --check` pass. The adjacent utils suite has one unrelated failure: a certificate fixture expired in 2021.

VERDICT: FIX

The existing matcher tests pass, but the patch has two correctness issues in [parse.go](/app/lib/utils/parse/parse.go:118):

- `Variable(`{{regexp.match("^a{2}$")}}`)` returns a template bracket error because its initial pattern rejects braces inside the quoted regexp. It must return the specified matcher-function error.
- `Match(`{{regexp.match("}}")`)` lacks a closing template delimiter, but the parser treats `}}` inside the quoted argument as that delimiter and returns the wrong error. Delimiter detection needs to account for quoted strings.

**Tests:** `go test ./lib/utils/parse` passed (`ok`, 0.004s). `git diff --check` passed. No test environment problem was observed. No project code was changed during this review.

Fixed matcher template parsing in [parse.go](/app/lib/utils/parse/parse.go). `Variable` now gives the required matcher-function error when a quoted regexp contains braces, and `Match` ignores `}}` inside quoted arguments when locating the closing delimiter. Added regression tests in [parse_test.go](/app/lib/utils/parse/parse_test.go).

`go test ./lib/utils/parse` and `git diff --check` pass.
